sscrn.policy: Create a read-only symlink view of candidate tree; ancestor directories of both selected TU and compile cwd are real (union); replace only selected TU with decompressed exact previous bytes. Preserve command source argument, relative include lookup, __FILE__ and __BASE_FILE__. Do not edit parent tree. All current dependency bytes except selected TU verified equal previous commit. Pin view and resolved paths at admission; full actual system dependencies must match candidate-normalized closure.
